agenda_items.title: TypeSpec in Service Mesh — Contract-Defined Service Boundaries and Communication Patterns
agenda_items.intent_description: Apply TypeSpec contracts within a service mesh architecture to define service boundaries and communication patterns. TypeSpec defines the shape of data flowing between services, enabling mesh-level validation of inter-service communication. Each service implements its TypeSpec contract; the mesh routes based on contract versions; contract changes trigger mesh-level orchestration (canary, blue-green, circuit breaking). TypeSpec becomes the shared language between development (service contracts) and operations (mesh configuration).
requirements: TypeSpec defines service boundaries in the mesh
Mesh routes based on contract versions
Contract changes trigger mesh orchestration (canary, blue-green)
TypeSpec = shared language between dev and ops
